thread:
miles: Heads-up — SuncrestPay reports 503s hitting their Dedicated Pool (pool-11) since 02:30 UTC after yesterday's runtime patch. This is customer P1/SLA risk. Need owners + short-term workaround by EOD. @ryan @liam
ryan: looking. can you share sample request ids and traces?
miles: got one: req=sr-9f8c2a. Error snippet: "503 Service Unavailable - no healthy backends". (logs attached in thread)
liam: I saw elevated tail latency on pool-11 earlier. suspect autoscaler + probe config. Can we pin to previous runtime image? /cc @jamal for rollback ops
jamal: I can roll back if we have an approved PR. What's the PR number?
ryan: PR is 4321 — runtime:revert-probe-fix. Need a quick code review and infra signoff. If rollback not possible, temporary routing patch: set max_inflight=80 for pool-11.
miles: Product (sophia-pm) says SuncrestPay expects a mitigation plan in 2 hours or they'll escalate. SLA is tight.
sophia-pm: Confirming. If we can't show workaround, they want credits pre-approved. Please prioritize.
ryan: attaching quick command to set max_inflight via admin CLI:
```
rctl set pool pool-11 max_inflight=80 --customer=SuncrestPay --reason="temp p99 mitigation"
```
miles: @deploy-bot what's the status of the canary rollback from earlier?
deploy-bot: Canary rollback for runtime:patch-2026-03-10 scheduled by @jamal at 03:10 UTC, status: pending approval.
jamal: Approving rollback now. I'll trigger and watch. If rollback fails, fallback is to shift 20% traffic to fallback region us-west-2.
liam: I'll open a short-lived routing rule: route customers.suncrestpay -> fallback if pool-11 p50 > 200ms for 3 mins. Pushing now.
ryan: Also pinging SRE on-call (sre-lead) for monitoring checks and postmortem ownership.
sre-lead: Oncall acked. I'll draft postmortem and start incident doc. Need timeline + who approved rollback + PR link.
miles: Action items:
- jamal: roll back runtime (ETA 15m) — update thread (owner)
- liam: routing fallback rule (ETA 10m) — update thread (owner)
- ryan: CR review + set max_inflight if needed (ETA 8m) — update thread (owner)
- sophia-pm: notify SuncrestPay status (ETA 20m) — customer comms
sophia-pm: Sending staging note to customer now. Will request permission to apply credits if needed.
miles: If rollback and routing apply, we should see 503s drop within one ramp cycle (~5m). Please paste metrics here when observed.
liam: metrics: 03:50 UTC — errors down 60%, p99 latency improving. continuing to monitor.
jamal: rollback completed at 03:54 UTC. no regressions so far. PR #4321 merged, runtime reverted.
ryan: Reviewed and green. I manually set max_inflight to 80 as backup.
sre-lead: Confirmed error rate back to baseline. I'm marking incident as mitigated; will keep it open for follow-up.
miles: thanks all. follow-up: postmortem owner = sre-lead, patch backport = ryan, rolling probe fix rework = liam. Closing after postmortem doc posted.
sophia-pm: I'll update customer with mitigation summary and next steps.
